maddeler.e:
اقتضبن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَضَبْنَ (iqtaḍabna) /iq.ta.dˤab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
# اُقْتُضِبْنَ (uqtuḍibna) /uq.tu.dˤib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
# اِقْتَضِبْنَ (iqtaḍibna) /iq.ta.dˤib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
